title: Linear-light colour spaces, contrast-color() and ctx.lang
blurb: Three colour and text APIs paired with drawElementImage(): side-by-side srgb and srgb-linear (or display-p3-linear) canvases blending neon badges, a card using CSS contrast-color() over a reactive canvas tint, and ctx.lang next to drawn CJK DOM text.
question: Do linear-light canvas colour spaces, CSS contrast-color() and CanvasTextDrawingStyles.lang work with drawElementImage()?
result: Side-by-side srgb and linear-light canvases compare blurred and overlapping neon controls, a registered --tint property drives contrast-color() on a drawn card, and ctx.lang sits next to a drawn span with CJK Han variants. Open the live checks below to see what your browser supports.
